items.title: Faster exact counting for formulas with explicitly computable low-communication leaf protocols
items.author: Valentine Kabanets; Sajin Koroth; Zhenjian Lu; Dimitrios Myrisiotis; Igor C. Oliveira
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete41-page five-author CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem5 and fullSection5.1–5.3 coreSAT proof, deterministic/randomized cases combined. Nonexclusive nativev1 private aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The algorithm constructs an explicit low-degree approximation by formula decomposition, expresses leaf protocols as sums of communication rectangles, and reorganizes partial-assignment counts into a narrow matrix product, balancing approximation precision and amplified randomized leaf costs to beat brute force.

proof_spans.label: EntireformalSection5.1–5.3 complete mainSAT algorithm proof, explicitprotocol and approximation dependencies
